close_reason: documented O(n) as intentional design choice
description: mailbox.rs handle_mailbox_query calls backend.get_objects::<Mailbox>(&account_id, None, None) to fetch all mailboxes and filters in-process. For an account with thousands of mailboxes (IMAP migration), this loads all mailbox metadata per query. The in-process approach is explicitly chosen because Mailbox/query is implemented here rather than delegated to the backend; the comment notes this. The efficiency issue is real but inherent to the design decision. Filed for tracking: if the account size grows this will be a bottleneck.
title: Mailbox/query fetches all mailboxes in-process — O(n) on every query
